# GeneFox Python client

GeneFox provides Python clients for the shared GeneFox scientific runtime. Install the package with `pip install genefox`.

# Getting started

Install the GeneFox CLI 1.1.0 or later; it carries the GeneFox runtime, which is proprietary and not bundled with this package. Then install the package with `pip install genefox`.

```python
import genefox
from genefox import api
s = genefox.Session(runtime="path/to/runtime", output="output")
status = api.account_status(s)
```


# ArrayExpress

Search studies, inspect their records and load processed expression; raw-only studies are not loadable. Search takes 1–5 s, details 2–10 s and expression 5–30 s. These calls are free.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

Expression with a gene and group can produce an engine PNG at the requested dpi and size; this summary call does not request one.

```python
hits = api.arrayexpress_search(s, query="spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy")
details = api.arrayexpress_details(s, accession="E-MTAB-6986")
expression = api.arrayexpress_expression(s, accession="E-MTAB-6986")
```

## Result fields

`arrayexpress-search`: `hits` (array), `total_hits` (integer), `source` (string).

`arrayexpress-details`: `source` (string), `accession` (string), `sample_count` (integer).

`arrayexpress-expression`: `source` (string), `accession` (string), `sample_count` (integer).


# cBioPortal

List curated studies, inspect composition and gene alterations. Alterations are study-wide, not restricted to an expression subset. Listing takes 1–10 s; composition and alterations take 5–60 s.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

These calls return rows, not figures.

```python
studies = api.cbioportal_studies(s)
composition = api.cbioportal_composition(s, study_id="openpedcan_v15")
alterations = api.cbioportal_alterations(s, study_id="openpedcan_v15", gene="TP53")
```

## Result fields

`cbioportal-studies`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`cbioportal-composition`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`cbioportal-alterations`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).


# Differential expression and enrichment

TCGA panel DE compares groups; imported enrichment analyzes a complete precomputed DE table and does not recompute DE. TCGA DE takes 10–60 s cold; imported enrichment is free local computation, with no latency stated. Imported enrichment requires the complete tested universe including nonsignificant genes, at least 500 distinct symbols, and raw p-values.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

TCGA DE can return an engine PNG at the requested dpi and size; imported enrichment produces optional reports rather than a figure.

```python
de = api.tcga_differential_expression(s, project="TCGA-BRCA", genes=["ESR1", "GATA3"])
# Supply a complete, precomputed table, not the panel result above.
from pathlib import Path
text = Path("complete-de.tsv").read_text()
enrichment = api.imported_de_enrichment(s, table=text, source="precomputed DE", comparison="treated versus control", complete_universe=True)
```

## Result fields

`tcga-differential-expression`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`imported-de-enrichment`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).


# Figures and local expression

Figure-producing tools accept format, dpi, width_in, height_in and size when listed in their signatures. The local expression interchange preserves inputs; it does not perform analysis or render a figure. The fixture conversion is local; analysis latency and free access depend on the tool.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

The fixture comprises `matrix.tsv`, `samples.tsv` and `experiment.json`. Request `format = "png"` for engine PNGs at the requested `dpi` and size; `svg` and `tiff` are also supported. Specify `width_in` and `height_in` together in inches instead of the `size` preset. For tools that support it, `recipe=True` requests a recipe for reopening the analysis. Saving does not convert formats. The fixture alone does not render a figure.

```python
# Run from the repository root; experiment.json describes these files.
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import genefox
base = Path("SDK/contracts/fixtures/local-expression/python")
matrix = pd.read_csv(base / "matrix.tsv", sep="\t", index_col=0)
samples = pd.read_csv(base / "samples.tsv", sep="\t", index_col=0)
x = genefox.ExpressionDataset.from_pandas(matrix, assay="logcounts", units="log2_cpm", sample_metadata=samples)
polars_frame = x.to_polars("logcounts")
adata = x.to_anndata("logcounts")
manifest = x.write_import("new-import-directory", assay="logcounts", scale="log2")
```

```python
# Given a figure-producing result named result:
result.figure.save("figure.png")
```

## Result fields

`tcga-expression`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).


# GEO

Find GEO series, inspect samples and plot expression; this is not per-device usability advice. Search takes 2–10 s, details 1–5 s, and expression 10 s–3 min cold.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

Figure-producing calls return engine PNGs at the requested dpi and size when requested and available.

```python
hits = api.geo_search(s, query="neuroblastoma")
details = api.geo_dataset_details(s, accession="GSE49711")
expression = api.geo_series_expression(s, accession="GSE49711", gene="MYCN", figure=True)
```

## Result fields

`geo-search`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`geo-dataset-details`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`geo-series-expression`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).


# Sample PCA

Project TCGA/GDC and GEO samples onto principal components; this is not a differential-expression test. TCGA PCA takes 30 s–5 min cold, then seconds; GEO requires a cold matrix download, then seconds.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

Figure-producing calls return engine PNGs at the requested dpi and size when requested and available.

```python
tcga = api.tcga_sample_pca(s, project="TCGA-BRCA", figure=True)
geo = api.geo_sample_pca(s, accession="GSE49711", figure=True)
```

## Result fields

`tcga-sample-pca`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`geo-sample-pca`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).


# Survival

Estimate TCGA/GDC patient survival by a clinical group; this is not a whole-cohort curve. Cold latency is 5–30 s.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

Figure-producing calls return engine PNGs at the requested dpi and size when requested and available.

```python
survival = api.tcga_survival(s, project="TCGA-BRCA", stratify="sex_at_birth", figure=True)
```

## Result fields

`tcga-survival`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).


# TCGA and GDC

Explore listed GDC projects, one gene’s expression and panel differential expression; this is not a genome-wide DE analysis. Project listing takes 1–3 s once, expression 5–40 s cold, and DE 10–60 s cold.

Cohort-wide analyses can take 5–60 s; the specific cold latencies above may be longer.

These examples use the session from Getting started and require the runtime.

Figure-producing calls return engine PNGs at the requested dpi and size when requested and available.

```python
projects = api.tcga_projects(s, search="BRCA")
expression = api.tcga_expression(s, project="TCGA-BRCA", gene="ESR1", figure=True)
de = api.tcga_differential_expression(s, project="TCGA-BRCA", genes=["ESR1", "GATA3"])
table = expression.table()
pandas_frame = table.to_pandas()
polars_frame = table.to_polars()
```

## Result fields

`tcga-projects`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`tcga-expression`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).

`tcga-differential-expression`: `data` (object), `display` (object), `caveats` (array).
